# SegmentLine { #timetoalign.timelines.SegmentLine }

```python
timelines.SegmentLine(**kwargs)
```

A timeline whose cached parameterized classes inherit the segment API.

## Methods

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [from_segmentation](#timetoalign.timelines.SegmentLine.from_segmentation) | Create a parameterized line from slices of an unchanged source. |

### from_segmentation { #timetoalign.timelines.SegmentLine.from_segmentation }

```python
timelines.SegmentLine.from_segmentation(source, split_coords, copy_events=True)
```

Create a parameterized line from slices of an unchanged source.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name         | Type                                                                  | Description                                                                 | Default    |
|--------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| source       | [Timeline](`timetoalign.timelines.base.Timeline`)                     | Timeline to segment (not modified).                                         | _required_ |
| split_coords | [list](`list`)\[[CoordinateSpec](`timetoalign.core.CoordinateSpec`)\] | Coordinates defining segment boundaries. k+1 coordinates create k segments. | _required_ |
| copy_events  | [bool](`bool`)                                                        | If True, copy events to their respective segments.                          | `True`     |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type            | Description                                              |
|--------|-----------------|----------------------------------------------------------|
|        | \'SegmentLine\' | New SegmentLine with segments typed to match ``source``. |

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                       | Description                                            |
|--------|----------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`) | If source already has children (ambiguous nesting).    |
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`) | If fewer than 2 split coordinates provided.            |
|        | [TypeError](`TypeError`)   | If a parameterized receiver does not match the source. |
